name: Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5
benefit: - **Stipend:** ₹500/- per trainee per day sanctioned as training expenditure. Out of this, ₹250/- is provided as a direct stipend to the trainee, and ₹250/- is utilized for material cost, training literature kit, and honorarium to resource persons.  - **Skill Development Training:** Training duration ranges from 2 to 5 days. Modules include fruit and vegetable preservation, canning, kitchen garden
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be willing to participate in horticulture-related skill development training.
